brief:
The transport and communications department in Hebron has warned that vehicle breakdowns during winter pose serious risks to drivers and pedestrians, the Ma'an news agency reported. The authority called attention to mechanical failures that increase in cold weather conditions.

The warning comes as winter driving conditions intensify across the region. The department urged vehicle owners to conduct regular maintenance checks and prepare their cars for seasonal hazards to reduce accident risks.
title: Hebron transport authority warns of winter vehicle hazards
